attractions.name: Birla Mandir
attractions.description: Temple with peaceful surroundings, suitable for a stroll or drive past
attractions.hours: 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM daily

attractions.name: Chokhi Dhani
attractions.description: Rajasthani village-themed dinner experience with folk performances, optional camel rides and local cuisine

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.description: Hilltop fort with courtyards, mirrorwork, Sheesh Mahal, Ganesh Pol, Zenana Courtyard, rampart walks and sweeping valley views

attractions.name: Jal Mahal
attractions.description: Palace floating on Man Sagar Lake, photographed from the waterfront promenade with the Aravalli hills behind; no entry inside

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.description: Royal palace complex with ornate courtyards, art-filled halls, Peacock Gate, Mubarak Mahal and royal textiles; residence of the Jaipur royal family

attractions.name: Jantar Mantar
attractions.description: Astronomical observatory built by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, with the world's largest stone sundial and instruments for measuring time, predicting eclipses and tracking stars

attractions.name: Johari Bazaar
attractions.description: Market for jewelry, lac bangles and textiles

attractions.name: Albert Hall Museum
attractions.description: Museum with Indo-Saracenic architecture and cultural artifacts
attractions.hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM and again from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM every day
attractions.entry_fee: ₹40 for Indian citizens, ₹300 for foreign nationals; Indian students ₹20, foreign students ₹150

attractions.name: Bapu Bazaar
attractions.description: Market for mojari shoes, block-print fabrics and trinkets

attractions.name: Jaigarh Fort
attractions.description: 'Fort of Victory' with intact fortifications, subterranean passages, the Jaivana Cannon, a museum of armour and artifacts, and rampart walks with valley views

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort
attractions.description: Picturesque Aravalli fort and former royal retreat, with Madhavendra Bhawan queens' suites, Sunset Point and panoramic views of the city
tips: Sunset Point is one of Jaipur's best panoramic viewpoints

attractions.name: Ram Niwas Bagh
attractions.description: Garden with fountains, home to Albert Hall Museum's Indo-Saracenic architecture

attractions.name: Panna Meena Ka Kund
attractions.description: Symmetrical 16th-century stepwell in Amber with zigzag stairs, a favorite of photographers

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
attractions.description: Jaipur's most photographed façade, with a honeycomb of pink sandstone windows designed for royal women to watch the street unseen
tips: Parking is limited; best visited with a hired vehicle drop-off

attractions.name: Elefantastic
attractions.description: Ethical sanctuary for rescued and rehabilitated elephants, offering guided interaction, feeding, walking alongside elephants and learning care routines; no riding allowed

attractions.name: Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing
attractions.description: Museum in a restored haveli near Amber celebrating block printing, with carved blocks, fabric panels and live craft demonstrations

attractions.name: Patrika Gate (Jawahar Circle)
attractions.description: Colourful gate whose arches are hand-painted with chapters of Rajasthan's history
tips: Visit at sunset for glowing pastel shades and soft light

attractions.name: Birla Temple
attractions.description: White marble temple at the foot of Moti Dungri Hill, glowing beautifully in the evening
tips: Peaceful atmosphere as lamps glow after sunset

attractions.name: Sheesh Mahal (Hall of Mirrors)
attractions.description: Hall of Mirrors located within Amber Fort

attractions.name: Ram Niwas Garden
attractions.description: A historic garden built by Maharaja Sawai Ram Singh
